comment: Banned-pattern lexicon. severity=hard: unambiguous slop, counts toward pass/fail. severity=soft: legitimate in some technical contexts (e.g. 'leverage' in finance), reported only. langs limits a pattern to outputs in that language; omitted = all.

structural.comment: Counted in code. Decorative listicle: >=threshold occurrences of '**Term:**' followed by a SHORT fragment (<8 words) that carries NO digit (a concrete spec value like '45-60 minutes' is legitimate structure, not padding). Em-dash density: PROSE em-dashes only (list-item and blockquote lines excluded, since one dash per labeled item is structural, not a prose tic) above emDashPerWordThreshold (0.02/word = 20 per 1000, ~2x the human prose rate per RESEARCH.md), min 3 dashes. Any emoji = hard hit unless the prompt contains emoji.
